data.one_liner: A Flutter terminal emulator widget with fast rendering and full VT/xterm support.
data.what_it_does: xterm2 provides a TerminalView widget that renders a terminal buffer and a Terminal model that parses escape sequences. It supports mobile, desktop, and web, and can be used standalone or with a custom frontend.
use_when: You need an embedded terminal in a Flutter app
You require fast 60fps rendering and wide character support
You want to customize the terminal theme or paint extensions
You need a pure‑Dart terminal core for non‑Flutter use
avoid_when: You only need a simple command line interface without a GUI
You are targeting very old Flutter versions (<3.27)
You need a terminal that integrates deeply with native terminal APIs
weaknesses: No built‑in SSH or networking support (needs external packages)
Limited to terminal emulation, not a full shell
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, create Terminal(), attach to TerminalView, set onOutput if needed
